alerts.message: 1 corner trimmer(s) coincident with existing perimeter rim framing omitted to avoid duplicate members; verify rim/trimmer connection design.
1 joist runs do not yet have confirmed beam/ledger bearing. Concept NOT cleared for construction; revise local beams or headers.
Alternative uniform joist sizes were compared, but some complex shapes still require a real trimmer/header load path review.
Some irregular areas need local headers or shared support beams; member reactions and hardware are NOT verified for construction.
Interior/shared beams may carry joists from two sides. Tributary beam and post reactions must be independently calculated.
One or more shared beams exceed the one-sided prescriptive beam load range; engineered design or added support required.
7 physical beam/post footprints project beyond the deck outline (5 dropped-beam, 2 post-6x6). Framing is NOT construction-ready; revise support geometry before approval.
14 conceptual footing pads extend beyond the deck projection. This is not automatically a code violation; verify footing size, site clearances, excavation and setbacks before construction.
5 angled corner beams proposed: one beam parallel to each angled edge carries the corner joists that cannot reach the main beam. Bearing, post loads and connections require AOS production review.
7 local support beams added for joists no shared beam could carry; confirm or redesign during AOS production review.
35 pairs of footings closer than 3 ft (AOS spacing guideline). Confirm they are needed or consolidate during production review.
12 beams have tributary load estimates outside the prescriptive one-sided reference range; engineered beam/extra bearing required.
Angled picture-frame edges require specialized support/blocking. Long 2x6 assemblies are generated only parallel to the joists.
Preliminary ledgers on house edges 8. Verify attachment viability, existing band joists, flashing, hardware, lateral connections and load path for EACH wall.
Framing layout is an explicit bearing concept, NOT a code-verified design. Joist/beam species, grade, spans, connections, ledger, post heights and footing loads require production review.
